g.text: Audio capture per source (Microphone or System): device -> 16 kHz AudioFrames -> Engine
component status Error and shows the notice
gap 80 ms..5 s -> fill with silence
gap > 5 s or > 500 ms ahead -> flush, re-anchor
Engine drops the frame when not
otherwise drop stream; reopen at once
and report error once via on_error
No stream: reopen() when retry_at is due
drop stream, flush assembler tail, emit
